resources.name: [concat(parameters('workspace'),'/Microsoft.SecurityInsights/',concat('Workbook-', last(split(variables('workbookId1'),'/'))))]

properties.description: Gain insights into SOCRadar threat feed indicators imported into Microsoft Sentinel. View indicator counts by type and collection, the import timeline and the audit log.

resources.description: SOCRadar Threat Feeds Dashboard provides visibility into imported threat indicators, collection statistics, and audit logs.

properties.description: SOCRadar-Feeds-Overview_HuntingQueries Hunting Query with template version 3.0.0

properties.query:
SOCRadar_Feeds_CL
| summarize IndicatorCount=dcount(IndicatorValue), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) by CollectionName, IndicatorType
| order by IndicatorCount desc

tags.name: description
tags.value: Overview of all threat intelligence indicators imported from SOCRadar feeds, grouped by collection and type.

properties.query:
SOCRadar_Feeds_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| summarize SeenCount=count(), Collections=dcount(CollectionName) by IndicatorValue, IndicatorType
| where SeenCount > 1
| order by SeenCount desc
| take 100

tags.name: description
tags.value: Most frequently seen threat indicators from SOCRadar feeds. Useful for identifying persistent threats.

properties.query:
SOCRadar_Feeds_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| summarize DailyCount=dcount(IndicatorValue) by CollectionName, bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| order by TimeGenerated desc, DailyCount desc

tags.name: description
tags.value: Daily import statistics per feed collection. Monitors feed health and volume trends.

properties.query:
SOCRadar_Feeds_Audit_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| summarize
    TotalRuns=count(),
    TotalCreated=sum(IndicatorsCreated),
    TotalSkipped=sum(IndicatorsSkipped),
    TotalFailed=sum(IndicatorsFailed),
    AvgDurationMs=avg(DurationMs),
    Failures=countif(Status == "Failed"),
    PartialRuns=countif(Status == "PartialSuccess"),
    LastRun=max(TimeGenerated)
  by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| order by TimeGenerated desc

tags.name: description
tags.value: Analyzes feed import operations from the audit log. Shows failed and partial runs and the indicators that did not reach Microsoft Sentinel.

metadata.description: Existing Microsoft Sentinel Log Analytics Workspace Name
SOCRadar Platform API Key
Include SOCRadar APT Recommended Block Hash feed (~500 indicators). Add more feeds via Custom Collection IDs.
Comma-separated custom feed collection UUIDs
Comma-separated custom collection names (matching IDs order)
On the first run of a collection, send only indicators last seen within this many days. 0 sends the whole feed.
How often to poll SOCRadar feeds (5-1440 minutes). Values of 60 or more are rounded down to whole hours.
Enable logging indicators to SOCRadar_Feeds_CL custom table (requires Infrastructure playbook)
Enable audit logging to SOCRadar_Feeds_Audit_CL custom table (requires Infrastructure playbook)
DCE endpoint URL for Feeds table (from Infrastructure playbook output)
DCR immutable ID for Feeds table (from Infrastructure playbook output)
DCE endpoint URL for Audit table (from Infrastructure playbook output)
DCR immutable ID for Audit table (from Infrastructure playbook output)
URL of the Function App package. Leave the default unless you host the package yourself.
Set automatically. Forces the package push to run again on a redeploy, which would otherwise reset WEBSITE_RUN_FROM_PACKAGE and leave the app empty.

properties.scriptContent: set -e; code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -L "$PACKAGE_URL"); [ "$code" = 200 ] || { echo "package URL returned HTTP $code"; exit 1; }; curl -sSL -o /tmp/package.zip "$PACKAGE_URL"; python3 -c "import zipfile;zipfile.ZipFile('/tmp/package.zip').testzip()" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'downloaded package is not a readable zip'; exit 1; }; echo "package downloaded: $(stat -c%s /tmp/package.zip) bytes"; echo 'reading the app storage connection while the role assignment propagates'; CONN=; for wait in $(seq 1 8); do CONN=$(az functionapp config appsettings list --name "$FA_NAME" --resource-group "$RG_NAME" --query "[?name=='AzureWebJobsStorage'].value" -o tsv 2>/dev/null || true); [ -n "$CONN" ] && break; echo "attempt $wait: the app settings are not readable yet"; sleep 15; done; [ -n "$CONN" ] || { echo 'the app settings stayed unreadable for two minutes: the Website Contributor assignment never became effective'; exit 1; }; SA=$(printf '%s' "$CONN" | sed -n 's/.*AccountName=\([^;]*\).*/\1/p'); [ -n "$SA" ] || { echo 'the app storage connection carries no AccountName'; exit 1; }; echo "staging the package in the app storage account $SA"; pointer() { az functionapp config appsettings list --name "$FA_NAME" --resource-group "$RG_NAME" --query "[?name=='WEBSITE_RUN_FROM_PACKAGE'].value" -o tsv 2>/dev/null; }; shape() { case "$(pointer)" in *function-releases*) echo blob;; 1) echo one;; '') echo missing;; *) echo other;; esac; }; staged() { [ "$(shape)" = blob ]; }; count() { az rest --method get --url "https://management.azure.com/subscriptions/$SUB_ID/resourceGroups/$RG_NAME/providers/Microsoft.Web/sites/$FA_NAME/functions?api-version=2023-12-01" --query 'length(value)' -o tsv 2>/dev/null || echo 0; }; indexed() { n=$(count); case "$n" in ''|*[!0-9]*) return 1;; esac; [ "$n" -ge 1 ]; }; BLOB=package-$(date -u +%Y%m%d%H%M%S).zip; for attempt in $(seq 1 6); do az storage container create --name function-releases --connection-string "$CONN" -o none >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; if az storage blob upload --container-name function-releases --name "$BLOB" --file /tmp/package.zip --overwrite --connection-string "$CONN" -o none >/dev/null 2>&1; then SAS=$(az storage blob generate-sas --container-name function-releases --name "$BLOB" --permissions r --expiry 2099-12-31T00:00:00Z --connection-string "$CONN" -o tsv 2>/dev/null); { [ -n "$SAS" ] && az functionapp config appsettings set --name "$FA_NAME" --resource-group "$RG_NAME" --settings "WEBSITE_RUN_FROM_PACKAGE=https://$SA.blob.core.windows.net/function-releases/$BLOB?$SAS" -o none >/dev/null 2>&1; } || echo "attempt $attempt: no read token was issued for the staged package"; else echo "attempt $attempt: the package upload failed; the readings decide"; fi; echo "attempt $attempt: pointer=$(shape) functions=$(count)"; staged && break; sleep 30; done; staged || { echo 'the package pointer never became a blob under function-releases: the app would have no code to reload'; exit 1; }; echo 'restarting the app so the host reloads the staged package'; az functionapp restart --name "$FA_NAME" --resource-group "$RG_NAME" -o none >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo 'the restart call did not go through; the readings decide'; for i in $(seq 1 40); do sleep 15; indexed && { echo "$(count) function(s) indexed after $((i * 15))s; run_on_startup triggers the first import"; exit 0; }; done; echo 'the package is staged but no function was indexed in 10 minutes'; exit 1

metadata.title: SOCRadar Feeds Infrastructure
metadata.description: Deploys data collection infrastructure for SOCRadar Threat Feeds: Data Collection Endpoint, custom tables (SOCRadar_Feeds_CL, SOCRadar_Feeds_Audit_CL), Data Collection Rules, and optional analytics workbook. Deploy this BEFORE the Function App playbook.

properties.descriptionHtml:
Note: Please refer to the following before installing the solution:

• Review the solution Release Notes

• There may be known issues pertaining to this Solution, please refer to them before installing.

The SOCRadar Threat Feeds solution for Microsoft Sentinel imports threat intelligence indicators from SOCRadar feed collections into Microsoft Sentinel using an Azure Function App. Supports recommended and custom feed collections with batch upload, checkpoint-based deduplication, and optional custom table logging.

Workbooks: 1, Hunting Queries: 4, Function Apps: 1, Playbooks: 1
